**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 02:56
- [FACT] The user revealed findings of a 2-year investigation.
- [FACT] The investigation focused on the Adani Group, an Indian conglomerate valued at INR 17.8 trillion (U.S. $218 billion).
- [FACT] Gautam Adani is the Founder and Chairman of the Adani Group.
- [FACT] Gautam Adani has a net worth of roughly $120 billion.
- [FACT] Gautam Adani added over $100 billion to his net worth in the past 3 years.
- [FACT] The stock prices of the Adani Group’s 7 key listed companies spiked an average of 819% in the past 3 years.
- [FACT] The user’s research involved speaking with dozens of individuals, including former senior executives of the Adani Group.
- [FACT] The user reviewed thousands of documents and conducted diligence site visits in almost half a dozen countries.
- [FACT] The 7 key listed companies of the Adani Group have 85% downside purely on a fundamental basis due to high valuations.
- [FACT] Key listed Adani companies have taken on substantial debt, including pledging shares of inflated stock for loans.
- [FACT] 5 of 7 key listed companies have reported ‘current ratios’ below 1, indicating near-term liquidity pressure.
- [FACT] 8 of 22 key leaders in the Adani Group are family members of Gautam Adani.
- [FACT] A former executive described the Adani Group as “a family business.”
- [FACT] The Adani Group has been the focus of 4 major government fraud investigations.
- [FACT] Allegations against the Adani Group include money laundering, theft of taxpayer funds, and corruption, totaling an estimated U.S. $17 billion.
- [FACT] Adani family members allegedly created offshore shell entities in tax-haven jurisdictions like Mauritius, the UAE, and Caribbean Islands.
- [FACT] These offshore entities generated forged import/export documentation to create fake turnover and siphon money from listed companies.
- [FACT] Gautam Adani’s younger brother, Rajesh Adani, was accused by the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) of involvement in a diamond trading import/export scheme around 2004-2005.
- [FACT] Rajesh Adani was arrested at least twice over separate allegations of forgery and tax fraud.
- [FACT] Rajesh Adani was subsequently promoted to Managing Director of Adani Group.
- [FACT] Gautam Adani’s brother-in-law, Samir Vora, was accused by the DRI of being a ringleader in the diamond trading scam.
- [FACT] Samir Vora was promoted to Executive Director of the Adani Australia division.
